notes: The default fresh route cross-checks candidate-submitted execution records, actual scripts/streams/order, and native artifact paths and SHA-256 values for internal consistency only.
The verifier distinguishes candidate scientific failure from unavailable runtime or unsupported audit methods: missing prerequisites return ERROR with no reward.
Unsupported estimators, finer-than-saved cadence, irregular bins and unequal paired numerical-audit block counts return not-evaluated with no reward.
The verifier package, including tests/_support/verifier/reference/, is mounted read-only for grading; execution evidence remains outside Agent-writable paths.
Candidate-consistent execution evidence does not authenticate scheduler origin; a mutually consistent fabricated evidence set cannot be distinguished from scheduler-origin evidence by hashes alone.

Freshness uses CASE01_EVAL_STARTED_AT_UTC injected by the single-trial host launcher and the grader's current UTC time; scheduler and native stage log windows must fall inside it. A direct Harbor run without this context is NOT_VERIFIED and cannot earn a science PASS.
The unused legacy broker helper was removed; the candidate image copies protocol.json, output-contract.json, and runtime-instructions.md. The active grader uses no legacy broker client.

evidence_model.compute: Remote production compute follows the unchanged task scientific requirements; candidate-declared resource fields and scheduler summaries do not establish execution provenance.
evidence_model.execution_evidence: The default fresh route checks the candidate-provided scheduler/accounting record, job/allocation/resource/time fields, submitted batch/workflow script, stdout/stderr, ordered stages, and native file hashes for consistency. It also requires scheduler and EM/NVT/NPT/production log windows to fall between evaluator-injected CASE01_EVAL_STARTED_AT_UTC and grader current UTC. Missing or inconsistent evidence returns FAIL with zero reward and science NOT_EVALUATED; missing evaluator window returns freshness NOT_VERIFIED with no reward. This is not independent scheduler or execution-origin attestation; fully consistent fabrication remains indistinguishable.
evidence_model.native_stage_evidence: The verifier independently re-extracts and audits candidate-native TPR, log, trajectory, and energy evidence and recomputes the scientific response under the existing gates. A short infrastructure run is not scientific evidence and cannot satisfy the 20 ns requirement.
evidence_model.downgrade: The separate case01-infra-short-execution-receipt-v1 with scope infra-short-gromacs is an infrastructure diagnostic only. It cannot satisfy the unchanged 20 ns native/scientific gates. Runtime or required dependency failures remain ERROR with no reward.
evidence_model.operator_route: Explicit evaluator external receipt and historical archive routes remain available. Candidate-artifact consistency does not establish independent_scheduler_attested or execution_origin_attested.
